auth_flow.login: 纯网页登录: BrowserWindow加载 LoginURL=https://wenku.baidu.com/pcClientLogin/login.html (main@929740); 客户端无账号密码逻辑
auth_flow.session_check: verifyLogin: 读 session.defaultSession.cookies(passport.baidu.com), 校验 BDUSS/BDUSS_BFESS/BAIDUID/BAIDUID_BFESS 四cookie, BFESS成对修复(只留BFESS时删BFESS留原值) (main@1063240区域)
auth_flow.request_auth: axios拦截器(module 97246@985000): 惰性取 passport.baidu.com 全量cookie拼 'Cookie: name=value; ...' 头注入每个请求; resetCookie()在登录态变化时失效缓存
auth_flow.cookie_sync_quirk: setLoginCookies: 把passport cookies复制到域 baidu-int.com (url=http://fedev_yg01.wk.wenku.baidu-int.com/, 1小时有效期) — 内网联调残留 (main@1064500区域)
auth_flow.logout: 遍历删除所有 baidu.com/baidu-int.com 域 cookie (main@1064700区域)
auth_flow.device_id: node-machine-id 1.1.12: Windows=REG QUERY HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography /v MachineGuid + sha256 (module 61572@698984); getDeviceInfo(module 54348@1059600): platform/hostname/cpu/mac/sysVer/appVer/deviceId/ip/sessionId(YYYYMMDDHHmmss-uuid13); IPC handle 'get-device-info'
auth_flow.unused_deps: node-rsa/speakeasy/spy-client 仅出现在内嵌package.json依赖清单(main@2011858), main.bundle 无任何import/调用 → 登录加密/TOTP假设证伪, 高置信

download_flow.client: 通用Electron下载管理: session will-download + IPC download-pause/resume/cancel/remove/open-when-done (main@1023825区域); 记录存 nedb userData/storage/downloads.db; 状态机 DOWNLOAD_FILE_STATUS(module 63734@931274: waiting/success/paused/failed/progressing/cancelled/deleted)
download_flow.doc_export: wenku文档导出与VIP门禁均在web页(server-side), 客户端仅提供 vipinfo 展示 + 文件落地承接; 无 download/export/getfile 直连CGI
